newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Lebanon gross reserves rise in mid-October.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Lebanon gross reserves rise in mid-October.

text.p: The Bank of Lebanon's gross foreign exchange reserves rose $96.9 million in the first half of October to $5,271.9 million from $5,175 million, according to the central bank's bi-monthly balance sheet issued on Thursday.
Gross reserves, which include commercial bank's foreign exchange deposits with the central bank, had risen by $131 million in the second half of September.
The balance sheet did not give the bank's net reserves but banking sources told Reuters they stood at $3,640 million in mid-October. Net reserves were $2,858 million at the end of 1995.
